source: Porta, Dalsasso, McCarty, Tuia: CanadaFireSat, arXiv 2506.08690 (v2, Nov 2025)

labels.burn_8d: S-NPP or NOAA-20 detection in the cell on t .. t+7
labels.new_burn_8d: Experiment 20 fire start (gap-filled S-NPP or NOAA-20 detection with none in the cell or its six neighbours on the previous 7 days) in the cell on t .. t+7
labels.ignition_8d: BCWS wildfire (type Fire) ignites in the cell on t .. t+7
labels.big_lightning_8d: BCWS lightning wildfire with CURRENT_SIZE >= 10 ha ignites in the cell on t .. t+7

test_negatives: per Fire Centre and year, 2 per positive, between the first and last positive date, excluding cells burned (satellite or BCWS) in 2018..y-1 and, for 2023, the 2022 negative cells; equal numbers per FWI decile
test_hard_negatives: 2 per positive per Fire Centre x dominant fuel class x month, matched to the positives' FWI deciles; cells burned in 2018..2022 excluded
threshold: maximizes F1 on the 2022 sample drawn like the test set, one threshold per model and label
